Page Title: About Harbor Quill
Sub-title: A reader-powered release where every recommendation earns rewards.

What is Harbor Quill?
Harbor Quill serves as the live proof of concept for CORA (Community Outreach Response Automation), the first system allowing independent creators to sell unlimited-mint NFT ebooks while paying readers genuine commissions and prize tickets for sharing them.
It launches on Base with my own raw memoir novella, “From Workshop Floor to Fresh Start,” and represents my public mission to help my household's recovery after a six-figure property fraud.

If CORA works here, Harbor Quill will become ArchiveLedger, a community-owned public-good platform for every creator.

Built on Cutting-Edge Technology

- Smart Contracts
Secure, audited Solidity deployed on Base.
- Chainlink VRF
Provides provably fair random winner selection for prize drawings.
- Aave Connector
Generates yield by depositing prize-pool funds.
- Base Network
Combines low fees and fast transactions with Ethereum security.
- Decentralized
The logic is fully on-chain from launch, initially protected by V1 safeguards and moving toward complete decentralization after battle-testing.

- Secure
Uses industry-leading protocols and best practices.

How It Works

Mint Your ebook NFT
Buy the ebook NFT for $30 USD; its mint number becomes your referral code.

Earn Through Referrals
Share the link or mint number. Every mint that uses it immediately earns you $10 USD, with no limits or expiration.
If no code is entered, $10 and the tickets go to a random existing ticket holder.

Accumulate Tickets
Each referral also awards tickets for the active Small & Big Block prize pools. More referrals produce more tickets and therefore better odds.

Win Prizes
Small Block: 8 × $900 after every 2,400 sales.
Big Block: 9 × $6,000 after every 180,000 sales.
Sales include both mints and secondary transactions.
Chainlink VRF selects winners randomly and fairly.

Claim Your Rewards
Commissions are sent automatically on-chain. Prize winners appear on the Winners page and can claim with one click whenever ready.

Key Features

Automatic Rewards: Smart contracts issue every payment immediately.
Fair Prize Selection: Chainlink VRF supplies true randomness.
Yield Generation: Prize pools generate yield through the Aave connector.
Gamification: Badges and leaderboards keep participation fun and competitive.
Transparency: Every transaction and rule is on-chain and verifiable.
Low Fees: Base provides speed with minimal transaction expenses.

Our Vision
Although Harbor Quill begins with one book, it is intended as only the first step.
The vision is a world where ebooks succeed according to merit, without gatekeepers or Amazon algorithms suppressing independent voices. Unknown and established creators alike should rise because audiences connect with their work—not because they manipulate a platform, have privileged connections, or purchase enough advertising.
Fans should be compensated for word-of-mouth promotion they previously provided for free, while anyone willing to hustle can earn after discovering a worthwhile title to share.

Our goal is a self-sustaining system that serves everyone: artists receive a fair share, fans and affiliates create real income, and communities form direct relationships. In that way, one underdog’s recovery can grow into a decentralized transformation for all creators, driven by aligned incentives rather than hype.
